text: Accepted collectSingleAddress reads mail.collect_addressbook when it needs a new card. An empty URI returns; a missing directory or read-only destination warns and returns. Earlier throw-based behavior is historical. Do not add a separate retained address-book instance or preference observer based only on the removed native implementation. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Current collection handles an unavailable configured book without aborting delivery
